tasks.label: Build and Run
args: cargo run; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; if (Test-Path ./target/debug/data) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force ./target/debug/data }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path ./target/debug/data | Out-Null; Copy-Item -Recurse -Force ./data-overlay/* ./target/debug/data/
